notes.title: Update - 1.0.6062.40003
notes.notes:
BoxesWithGuns jumps right into the next round. Check out the new update:

- Adjust Bloom/Blur intensity by switching the particle level
- Bosses are going to spawn every wave. Those bosses drops up to 50x the amount of money which a single enemy would do. So go for it
- No more camping possible. (Bosses will catch you up)
- Huge performance and collision improvements
- Receive announcements directly in the game
- Bugfixes and much more...

For a more detailed information, check out the game forum or click on the announcements in game. http://www.indie-dev.at/?forum=boxeswithguns/announcements

Happy gaming!
